task.title: M10 effective tool-call budgets and script correctness
task.description: Implement phase0 AC3–5 and make T6 RED tests green. Add a real independent optional tool-call cap counted at actual invocation boundary, preserve round budget and report truthful terminal reason. Fix stress JSON resolver, validate missing/invalid bound port, add strict scripts TypeScript target wired into project check and fix classified script diagnostics without weakening strictness or running models. Read T8-input.json and T6 evidence.

acceptance_criteria: AC3: M10: offline stub proves the actual configured round/call budget stops execution with a truthful terminal reason; maxToolCalls is never silently ignored or represented by maxRounds.
AC4: M10: stress JSON creation uses an existing resolver and writes a report in the offline fixture; optional containment port is handled with no unsafe default.
AC5: M10: a scripts TypeScript check covers the benchmark/stress scripts and fails on an injected type error; root and scripts checks pass without external model calls.
constraints: Use local tests-creator skill and testing context; graph/wiki before deeper reads, keryx ctx rg only for code search.
Do not edit flow.json or frozen acceptance criteria; parent owns all flow transitions.
Stats disabled; no external model calls, no private dataset copying.
Do not modify unrelated files. Coordinate shared test file ownership before edits.
Return STATUS first and validate subagent-result; persist RED command/output and test_case_specs in artifacts.

Own src/commands/agent.ts and direct associated budget types/tests, scripts/benchmark and scripts/stress necessary corrections, scripts/typecheck.test.ts, tsconfig.scripts.json and package.json typecheck/check scripts only. Do not change dependencies/lockfiles, routing/template/init/update/rules, skill schemas, security implementations or frozen docs. Coordinate any ownership expansion.

Root fixed description-based input schema (optional issue_number). Validate using bun src/cli.ts skills contracts validate ... --schema task-implementer-input because global binary still ships old schema; do not fabricate issue numbers.
auto_commit=false. Full source CLI/current tests, not stale generated global implementation. Do not claim skipped ESLint is passed; parent integrates gates separately.

Read FULL local task-implementer skill. Validate limit inputs and interaction with approvals/unknown calls/multiple rounds; preserve existing stop reasons when cap not reached. Add meaningful missed edge tests if needed, do not weaken T6 tests.
